findings.evidence: The 89-line 'Worked example' repeats familiar scaffolding ('info: {title: Users, version: "1"}', 'id: string;', 'email: string;') and demonstrates mappings already specified in Workflow, Naming algorithm and Mapping decisions. Although its edge cases are useful, activation and repetition occupy a substantial share of the line-weighted body.
findings.fix: Condense the worked example to short before/after snippets demonstrating inherited parameters, ignored $ref siblings, request projections and operation-name collisions. Reuse evals/files/pets-api.yaml when a complete input document is needed, retaining the specialist decisions without repeating the routine YAML and interface scaffolding.
